data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding decreased from GBP 19.043m at 1 January 2021 to GBP 14.774m at 31 December 2021. The report does not provide a single explicit gross quantified prior-year movement figure (prior-year development) for years before 2020; accordingly a precise prior-year development figure could not be extracted. Narrative references point to prudent reserving and general favourable development contributing to the improvement in the technical result.
raw_causal_phrases: which is predominantly due to prudent reserving.
The purchase of additional life facultative reinsurance has resulted in a reduction in overall earned premium.
The recent tragic invasion of Ukraine which has sparked war in Eastern Europe is an ongoing reminder of the complexities the syndicate faces when navigating risk.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening and other statement amounts in the accounts are presented in GBP '000 and have been converted to millions. The report does not state an explicit GROSS prior-year (pre-2020) reserve movement figure. A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes but the PDF extraction did not provide full cumulative development rows suitable for calculating prior-year development per the required diagonal method; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. The balance sheet gross claims outstanding (opening) was used as the primary source.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table exists in the notes (shows development percentages and a gross outstanding row in GBP millions), but full development-period cumulative monetary rows required to compute prior-year development (previous-diagonal comparisons) could not be reliably extracted from the source. Consult page 37 of the report for the original triangle.
